summary: Backend-only test of Jokoo Sponsorisations Provider Payment System. All 21 pytest cases passed against the preview URL. Covered: public prices endpoint, admin GET/PUT prices with full validation matrix (negative amount 400, invalid day 99 400, non-admin 403, empty body 400, changes reflected on public endpoint, defaults restored), sponsorship creation (pending_payment + correct amount_xof), Stripe card checkout (returns url + session_id), non-owner checkout 404, Wave/Orange endpoints reachable (503/500 acceptable — mocked), pro & admin list endpoints, admin PATCH gift activates sponsorship + creates notification + sets provider.sponsored_until, and auto-expiration on GET /sponsorships/mine after tampering ends_at in DB (status flips to expired and provider.sponsored_until cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4373 — POST /sponsorships returns doc via dict comprehension excluding _id. OK.
server.py:4327 — PUT /admin/sponsorships/prices accepts both `{prices:{...}}` and flat `{...}`. Empty body correctly rejected with 400 via `if not cleaned` branch.

server.py:4485 — Orange checkout now correctly uses `om_create_webpayment` with `notif_url` (previous blocker fixed and verified — wave/orange endpoints reachable, returning 503 as expected when creds absent).
server.py:4417 — `_expire_stale_sponsorships` is invoked in both `/sponsorships/mine` and `/admin/sponsorships`. Verified to flip status and unset provider.sponsored_until.
server.py:4561 — Gift path in PATCH /admin/sponsorships/{sid} correctly activates and inserts a `sponsorship_gifted` notification.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used existing seeded accounts admin@jokoo.sn and pro@jokoo.sn. Sponsorship docs were created via the pending flow and the admin gift path — persisted in `sponsorships` collection under provider `pro@jokoo.sn`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sponsorisation backend is fully green. If retesting, note that TestSponsorshipLifecycle uses the SAME sponsorship id for card/wave/orange checkout in sequence (still pending since Stripe test session not paid), which is representative of user flow. Auto-expiration test tampers with `ends_at` via direct Mongo write (MONGO_URL + DB_NAME=jokoo_db). Wave/Orange 503 is acceptable per spec — do NOT flag.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. Previous blocker `om_create_checkout` undefined was already fixed in server.py:4485 to use `om_create_webpayment(..., notif_url=...)`. Verified: Orange checkout call reaches the payment adapter and returns 503 gracefully when creds are missing (expected & documented as mocked).
